title: Agent evals
summary: Agent evals measure task outcomes and behavior using repeatable scenarios and explicit grading rules.
overview: Evaluate the model and harness together across multiple trials. Check resulting system state as well as the transcript, using graders appropriate to the task.
why: A convincing final message does not establish that the requested action succeeded.
example: A ticket-resolution eval checks that the right ticket changed, required fields are present, and unrelated tickets remain untouched.
judgment: Define representative tasks, unacceptable failures, and how human review calibrates subjective graders.
next: Which recent production failure is missing from our regression scenarios?
